Lena (Support): FYI - customer Solara (tenant: solara-trial-7) hitting repeated 429s during trial seat activation. Support tried rate-limit backoff; still failing. Escalating to CS for outreach and priority handling.
Omar (CS Lead): Thanks. Can we offer a temporary unblock?
Rico (Solutions Eng): We can enable a temporary bypass route to a small fallback pool. Command: curl -X POST /internal/reroute -d '{"tenant":"solara-trial-7","pool":"fallback-provision"}'
Lena (Support): Infra approved. I can apply and monitor.
Sofia (CSM): I'll draft a 10m ack email & propose a 30m sync. This trial has strong expansion signals; we should offer a credit if activation delayed.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-1902 (P2)
Omar (CS Lead): Assigning roles: Sofia = comms + customer call, Lena = execute reroute + monitoring, Rico = SE support. Keep updates here.
Lena (Support): Reroute applied, return 200. Monitoring success rate.
Rico (Solutions Eng): Metrics improving, backlog clearing. Recommend expiry on rule after 3h.
Sofia (CSM): Customer replied: "Thanks, saw the update and able to add first user." Scheduling follow-up demo.
Omar (CS Lead): Good work. After postmortem, add a short playbook item to onboarding docs.
